reviews.text: We had such a wonderful experience with Wendy and her team, specifically Katie and Sandy. They cared for our dogs as if they were their own. They communicated after each visit and sent photos. They went above and beyond in their services. We will absolutely use Pampered Pups again.

Pampered Pups is everything you want in a dog sitter.   Great daily feedback/pix helped us get comfortable with getting away plus Wendy and Kate took care of the mail, paper, plants, and quickly won over the more wary of our two little mutts.   The price was very reasonable for 5 days x 2 visits per day, walks, food, belly rubs, mail, plants, etc.  They will be our go-to sitters.
we might even leave the baby with them next time.  (kidding).
Thanks for everything W & K.

I can’t say enough nice things about Wendy and Pampered Pups. I have a rescued Frenchie who I had not left since I got him a year ago so I was anxious about leaving him. But Wendy came and met him before I left him with her. Then we agreed she would walk him a few days ahead of the weekend she was going to babysit him. She went above and beyond to make him feel comfortable and I received frequent pictures, notes and updates about their walks, dinner and sleeping situations. All were positive. When I got home my baby was excited to see me but he didn’t act crazy - I could tell he wasn’t stressed or scared or neglected in anyway.  I will always use Pampered Pups when I have to leave town. It was a pleasure not to worry about my fuzzy baby while I was gone.

Wendy cared for our dog and bearded dragon while we were away for the weekend. Her visits were right on time and her messages to us after each visit were informative and kept us at ease knowing our animals were well cared for while we were away. We will definitely be using her again!

Wendy did a great job with our Doberman!  He is very protective of our home but Wendy won him over through small steps of building trust.  He is a kind soul (but protective) and once he trusted Wendy they became good friends.  To know he was ok and well cared for was a great worry off our shoulders and allowed us to enjoy our trip.  Thank you Wendy!

Wendy and Dori are wonderful, caring people. They always do a great job and truly care about taking care of pets. I loved getting pictures of our dog when we were away and all the messages. I have used them several times and will continue in the future. Very professional and dependable.
Always excellent! We've used thus service for years and they are always professional and caring for our pets. We always feel like our cats in good hands when we are out of town.

So thankful we found Pampered Pups and our walker Dori! It’s so comforting having such an easy booking service paired with a team you can trust in your home and who loves our fur babies as much as we do! 10/10 recommend!

Great care of our golden retriever in our home. Feeding, walks, play time...PP cares for our pet family member as well as we do.  It makes us feel more at ease when we have to leave knowing he is in his familiar surroundings and with someone who clearly loves being a caregiver.  SO MUCH BETTER than a kennel boarding option.

Such a peace of mind, when I go out of town, Wendy takes great care of my 12 year old pup and has done so for about 10 years!  My dog, Abby, loves and trusts Wendy, as well as Dave, who helps Wendy with Abby.  Abby has visits 3x a day, getting fed, pottied ,  walked and meds given; Pictures are taken of Abby during each visit to show me how Abby is doing. Wendy has also extended Abby's care when my flight did not return as scheduled!  Wendy and Dave are the GREATEST! and I trust her with my precious pup!

We have used Pampered Pups to let our two pups out in the backyard for walks multiple times a week for around a year. They are very good with our big dogs, keep the rhythm our pups are used to, provide regular and timely communication and scheduling, and are very sweet. We will continue to use them as long as we live within their radius; we are very happy!

Pampered Pups is so easy to work with and makes booking easy with the app. They have taken great care of our two guys and provide a detailed report each time. Always on time and always professional. We love having this service nearby!

Started using Pampered Pups last August to walk my chihuahua-terrier mix after I had knee replacement surgery. Wendy is great- flexible, easy to work with, reliable, & nice. I still have her come 2x per week & my dog Bix loves her- "Wendy Days" are his favorite times of the week.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Pampered Pups. Susan, Betty, Sandy, Wendy, and Jan are truly an incredible team, and I feel so incredibly blessed to have them caring for my dogs.
From day one, they have shown unwavering commitment — they show up exactly when they’re supposed to, take the time to walk my dogs properly, and most importantly, they genuinely love on them. My dogs are my children, and trusting someone with them is not something I take lightly. With Pampered Pups, I have complete confidence and peace of mind.
Knowing that my pups are cared for with consistency, kindness, and affection makes all the difference in my life. I need the help, and having a team that treats my pets as their own is truly priceless. Their reliability, compassion, and professionalism set them apart.
If you’re looking for a pet care team you can trust with your whole heart, Pampered Pups is it. I am beyond grateful for each and every one of them.
Thank you.

Wendy and her team are amazing. One of my dogs is a rescue and scared of everyone, but Wendy and her team do an incredible job with him. Pampered pups dog sitting is the very best. They are trust worthy and really care and love the dogs they take of. I highly recommend their services to anyone!

We are so grateful for the amazing care our pets received with in-home sitting while we were away. Knowing they were comfortable in their own space gave us total peace of mind, and communication was great the entire time. We came home to happy pets and a well cared for home and would absolutely trust and recommend them again without hesitation.

Wendy and Dawn were our regular puppy walkers and I don’t have enough good things to say!! Professional, timely, courteous, respectful of our space, and an abundance of love for our little puppies. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for their services.
I recently hired Wendy to help care for my elderly dog while traveling and she is amazing.  My dog Ray loves her and I loved all of her communication and updates.  I highly recommend her!

I cannot recommend Pampered Pups Dog Sitting highly enough! I’ve been using their services for over a year, and I truly trust Wendy and her team with my life. My 8-year-old corgi is extremely stubborn and doesn’t handle changes to his routine or new people very well, but every time a Pampered Pups dog sitter cares for him, he is calm, happy and well-loved!

The team is reliable, attentive, and genuinely caring. I travel frequently, sometimes several times a month for work, and knowing that he’s in such capable hands gives me complete peace of mind whenever I’m away (which I cannot say for other boarding facilities or pet sitting companies I have used). I also love their app and the daily photos and updates I receive!

If you’re looking for a pet sitting service that you can really trust, this is the one! This has been an absolute blessing in my life!

Wendy at Pampered Pups (in my case, a cat) was a pleasure to work with!  She took excellent care of my cat while we were traveling for 2 weeks.  She is very professional, knowledgeable, and trustworthy!   They send daily communications and pictures of your pet(s), so you can rest assured your pets are being well cared for!  We will definitely use Pampered Pups (and cats!) services again the next time we go out of town.
Wendy is awesome! Always takes great care of my cats!

I cannot recommend Pampered Pups highly enough! Choosing someone to come into my home and care for my dogs is not a decision I take lightly—but from the very first interaction, I knew they were the right fit.

The team is not only professional and dependable, but they’re also incredibly kind, attentive, and truly passionate about animals. My pups absolutely adore them, and it gives me so much peace of mind knowing they’re in such loving hands when I’m away.

They provide detailed updates and photos after each visit, which is such a comfort, and they always go above and beyond—from playtime to belly rubs to keeping routines consistent. It’s clear they treat each pet like their own.

If you’re looking for someone trustworthy and caring to look after your furry family members, look no further. I feel incredibly lucky to have found Pampered Pets and would confidently recommend them to anyone!

We used Pampered Pets for the first time and loved them. Wendy and team are very detailed and love dogs. The app is amazing and you get all photos and updates within minutes. I recommend using them!! Our dog was so loved, relaxed and happy when we came home!
Wendy and Katy were great! Will definitely use again when we are traveling!

Wendy is amazing!! This is the first time I traveled and family couldn’t come stay with my dogs. Wendy was so sweet about my “crazy dog mom” moment before I left (lol). She sent pictures and a full report of my boys during each visit - absolutely made me feel good knowing they were in great hands. Will definitely call Wendy again when I head out of town!

Dogs were very happy.  Service was impeccable.  Communication was flawless.  Very reasonable pricing.

We will definitely use Pampered Pups again.
Nancy, thank you for taking excellent care of Dolly and Doobie.  We appreciate you.

I am a full time working mom with a three year old. At the end of the day, on most weekdays, I plop on the couch and just love on my dogs. But bummer is that they need more than that. When we adopted our Golden in July and he immediately gained 10 lbs it became evident. Long story short my favorite service I've ever had is Pampered Pups Dog Sitting. She walks my sweet babes, gives lots of exercise and cuddles, and if I have to work late I don't feel the same guilt. I consider myself lucky to have someone so trustworthy and loving in my life as Wendy and the entire team. I do not get paid for this ad, and if I still had my house on the busy four way stop at Melrose and Waterview, you'd still see her sign

Pampered Pups is a life-saver! My husband and I both work outside of the house, and it's so nice to be able to fully trust someone with your fur baby in your home. Our daily dog walker treats our crazy boxer like she is family. Thank you!!

I've been using this service for 24 years and I couldn't be happier! We feel confident in our cats' care while we are away because of the reliability, professionalism, trustworthiness, and care from the Pampered Pups team. They are so accommodating to our kitties' special needs. We have neighbors who offer to help for free, yet we choose to pay for the peace of mind of knowing that our furry loved ones are in the best possible hands with Pampered Pups.

We have used Pampered Pups Dog Sitting for about 4+ years now and we highly recommend!!!! Communications and availability is always A+!! My cats enjoy the visits and they are always well taken care of! I really enjoy the photos she sends of my fur babies while I'm gone! Highly recommend!

We are so grateful to have Wendy and her Pampered Pets dog walking team! They are absolutely wonderful with our our doodles Yaz and Tuxx.
Her team treats them with care, patience, and love as if they were their own. Our dogs always look forward to their walks and come back happy and well-exercised.

Also they are incredibly reliable, punctual, and professional, which gives us so much peace of mind knowing our pets are in good hands.

We highly recommend Pampered Pets to anyone looking for exceptional care for their furry family members!

RS
Thank you Lauren! We enjoyed caring for your sweet pup!
They are absolutely wonderful! Tracey and Wendy took care of my little dog like their own! Gave her so much love during our time in the area! I highly recommend them!

Highly recommend Pampered Pups! Wendy responded to my questions promptly.

Nancy watched our dog while we were out of the country and went above and beyond to take excellent care of her! We are beyond grateful for the top notch care Nancy provided our dog and highly recommend her!

We have a special situation with 2 indoor cats and outside, in our fenced backyard, we have a goat… and Wendy & Crew at Pampered Pets have managed to take great care of all three pets for us many times over the last several years… plus, I …
Sandy took great care of our special needs senior dog. We had peace of mind knowing someone was at our home caring for our dog like we would.
Great experience! My dogs loved them and were very well taken care of!
Wendy and her team provide great peace of mind when we are traveling.  Our kitties are happy and well cared for while we are away--including cuddle time! Simply the best.

We have used Pampered Pups multiple times to take care of our little dog. Wendy and her team take excellent care of our sweet boy-- they think of everything, even reminding me to leave out a towel so they can wipe the dog's feet if rain is …
